page.title: VCell Database Info Panel
page.introduction:
The Database File Info tab (lower right of a BioModel document window) displays basic information about a model as it is stored in the VCell Database. The summary displays information about some of the internal contents of a model. In the Welcome window, the same information is shown when you hover over a model in the VCell Database lists.
The tab appears when you select the open BioModel itself (the top node of the tree in the upper left). It reflects the model's last saved version, as a notice at the top of the tab points out, so changes made since then do not appear. A model that has never been saved to the VCell Database has no database record; the tab is then titled Database File Info — NOT SAVED and asks you to save the model.
